idea-plugin.name: Bracket Colorizer
idea-plugin.description:
Colorizes matching brackets by nesting depth ("rainbow brackets"): every pair of (), [], {} (and optionally <>) gets the color of its nesting level, so brackets that sit inside each other are easy to tell apart.

Uses each language's syntax highlighter to avoid recognized comments, strings, regular expression literals, and markup text. Files without a working syntax highlighter are left unchanged.

The colors are fully configurable, either in the Bracket Colorizer tool window on the right hand side of the IDE (applied live) or under Settings | Editor | Bracket Colorizer: pick a color per nesting level, add or remove levels, and optionally mark unmatched brackets.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial public release with configurable nesting colors, live tool window settings, unmatched bracket highlighting, and optional angle bracket support.
